name: logicprobe
description: Design document & plan claim verification — logic primitives + adversarial probing for behavioral claims. State machines, protocol logic, and refactoring plans get executable-model verification (7 structural + 7 adversarial checks) with regression detection.

interface.shortDescription: Claim verification for design docs & plans — logic primitives + adversarial probing
interface.longDescription: Documents are not truth — code is. Verifies every verifiable claim in design documents, architecture specs, and refactoring plans against the actual codebase, then escalates to executable-model verification for behavioral claims: 7 structural checks and 7 adversarial probes. Refactoring plans get before/after model comparison for regression detection. Python harness included, with manual fallback for air-gapped machines.
